description: Where a batch got to: whether it is still running, how many of its URLs now have a verdict, how many of those the web or our policy refused, how many were never attempted, and what it has spent so far. Ask for `items` to get the results themselves: the pages and the refusals, in the order you submitted them, each one the same answer a single `scrape` would have given. You get up to 200 at a time, from wherever `from` says. A batch whose results have expired still answers with everything else, because somebody who paid for those pages must never be told the batch does not exist.

from.description: Start the results at this position. Up to 200 come back at a time, so read the next page with `from` plus however many you just got, and stop when you reach `total`.

id.description: The batch's id, as create returned it.

items.description: Also return the results themselves, in the order you submitted them. Off by default: most polls only want to know whether the batch has finished.

name: get_batch
title: Read one batch
